picks.editorial_note: OpenAI's claim of an AI-generated analytic proof addressing part of the Navier-Stokes Millennium Prize Problem, produced by roughly 10,000 autonomous agents, would be one of the most significant AI-for-math results to date if it holds up to peer scrutiny.
picks.title: Solução de problema matemático: como a IA está impactando a ciência? - Jornal da Unicamp

picks.editorial_note: CERN's strategic partnership with Mistral to build a foundation model trained on billions of simulated particle collisions signals a major convergence of frontier AI labs and big science, with potential to accelerate discovery across high-energy physics.
picks.title: CERN and Mistral join forces to accelerate AI for science – Home

picks.editorial_note: DOE's Genesis Mission, unveiled at the NAE annual meeting, aims to link national supercomputers, datasets, and experimental facilities into a unified AI-for-science infrastructure — a flagship federal bet on accelerating discovery.
picks.title: NAE Annual Meeting Spotlights DOE’s New Genesis Project and Other AI Initiatives Aimed at Advancing Discovery

picks.editorial_note: A White House-announced consortium of 14+ Southeastern universities to build shared AI supercomputing infrastructure marks a notable federal push to expand regional AI research capacity beyond traditional tech hubs.
picks.title: Vanderbilt among founding members of Southeast Regional SI Computing Consortium

picks.editorial_note: A $28.6 million multi-institution federal award anchored at Brown will develop machine learning tools to study protein misfolding in neurodegenerative disease, a substantial bet on AI-driven biomedical research.
picks.title: Brown scholar to play key role in federally funded project to prevent neurodegenerative disease

picks.editorial_note: Arkansas's AURORA project — a robot-controlled, AI-enhanced 'self-driving lab' backed by $20 million in NSF funding — represents a concrete, novel application of AI to speed up physical materials discovery.
picks.title: Robots and AI Could Speed Search for Quantum Materials

picks.editorial_note: A $19.2 million, five-year Army Research Office award to a UCF-led team to advance optical sensing and computational imaging shows sustained defense investment in AI-enabled physical science.
picks.title: UCF-Led Team Receives $19.2 Million Army Research Office Award to Advance the Science of Light

picks.editorial_note: ASU's new AI Research Acceleration Platform, enabled by an Intel donation, broadens access to advanced AI supercomputing for all students and researchers, a meaningful step toward democratizing AI research infrastructure.
picks.title: ASU provides access to AI-supercomputing for all

picks.editorial_note: A $2.2 million Google.org grant to ANU for a two-tiered AI engine mapping chemotherapy resistance mechanisms illustrates how targeted AI-for-science funding is translating into concrete cancer research tools.
picks.title: AI for science: Google.org funding to support ANU-led chemotherapy resistance cancer research

picks.editorial_note: Georgia Tech's research into detecting internal warning signs of unsafe or misaligned AI behavior, prompted by a real 2026 incident, addresses a pressing AI-safety gap with direct relevance to future AI policy and oversight.
picks.title: Can We Detect Harmful AI Before It’s Too Late? Researchers Search for Warning Signs
